transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hi there! Do you have any questions about your cataract surgery or recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do have a few questions. Firstly, when can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You should avoid any exercise for 1 week after surgery, but after that, you can go back to light exercise, such as gardening. However, you should avoid strenuous exercise for a month. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I was wondering when I can start using my eye gel for dry eyes again?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: If you were using any eye drops before your operation, such as for dry eyes, it's safe to continue using them, unless you've been told otherwise. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thank you, that's helpful to know. Another thing I've noticed is that I'm very sensitive to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.intended: It's normal for your eyes to be a bit sensitive to light as they adjust to the new lenses. However, significant pain when it's bright or severe light sensitivity is not normal, especially if your eye is also red and painful, and we may need to assess this further. If it's mild and things just seem brighter than you're used to, we'd recommend just wearing sunglasses when you're going outside. Do you have any other questions?
transcript.delivered: It's normal for your eyes to be a bit sensitive to light as they adjust to the new lenses. However, significant pain when it's bright or severe light sensitivity is not normal, especially if your eye is also red and painful,

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: I'm sorry to interrupt, but should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
It’s common for the vision to not be completely clear in the first week after your operation. But this should improve quickly and settle down over time. If your vision is still blurry, or getting significantly worse or blurry, we may need to check it to make sure it’s okay.

To finish answering your previous question about light sensitivity: if it's mild and things just seem brighter than you're used to, we'd recommend just wearing sunglasses when you're going outside. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thank you for the information. I don't have any more questions right now. I appreciate your help!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You're welcome! Just to confirm, have all your questions been answered?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, all my questions have been answered. Thank you once again!
